KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mitoto
   C. mato
   D. watoto

2. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

3. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. pana
   C. nene
   D. fupi

4. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

5. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

6. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.

7. When practising asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   B. Copy random text without understanding asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   C. Use insults to “practise” asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   D. Avoid reading anything related to asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

8. When practising Kuzungumza:Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

9. When practising huyu na hawa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to huyu na hawa.
   B. Copy random text without understanding huyu na hawa.
   C. Use insults to “practise” huyu na hawa.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain majina and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Kuzungumza:Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain huyu na hawa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
